name: Credly
summary: Digital credential platform for designing, issuing, managing, verifying and analysing badges and skills credentials.

value: Issue credentials for courses and certifications
Connect credential records to learning and talent systems

researchTasks: Imported from the The Learning Curve assessment & credentialing dataset (research snapshot 16 Nov 2026). Evidence status: Vendor-supplied product, integrations and Open Badges pages; 1EdTech Open Badges 3.0 specification is independent standards evidence.

AI: No specific AI capability confirmed in reviewed credential product pages. Model/provider: Not disclosed / no model confirmed. Training: Not disclosed; vendor confirmation required. Retention: Credential records are intended to persist; request retention/deletion rules for learner personal data and analytics. Subprocessors: Request current processor/subprocessor list and data residency. Status: No AI feature established in reviewed pages; explicit vendor confirmation required.

Vendor outreach (Medium priority): Confirm Open Badges 3.0 certification, CLR support, API and integration coverage; AI use; data residency; SOC/ISO certificates; privacy/retention; ACR; learner portability and export.
Check the 1EdTech Open Badges 3.0 conformance directory (https://www.imsglobal.org/spec/ob/v3p0/impl/) for a current certification.

dataGaps.note: Open Badges 3.0 compatibility is described on a feature page; conformance certification not checked. Open Badges 3.0 feature page describes compatibility and metadata; verify current conformance/certification and CLR support.
Request credential issuer/learner portal ACR/VPAT and WCAG test evidence.
Vendor states ISO certifications and GDPR compliance; obtain current certificate names, scope and validity, SOC 2 status, DPA and subprocessors.
